environment.description: Same NestJS microservice deployed in EKS (v1.28) pod with ephemeral credential injection via Vault Agent sidecar (injector v1.3.1). Pod spec includes a projected volume with serviceAccountToken audience-bound to 'vault' with 90s expiry. The Vault role config uses token_bound_cidrs restricting issuance to pod CIDR 10.244.0.0/16 and token_num_uses=1. Additionally, the pod runs with a read-only root filesystem (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true in securityContext) and an AppArmor profile (runtime/default) that denies read access to paths outside /app/** and /tmp/**. The service mesh (Istio 1.20 with STRICT mTLS) requires per-request SPIFFE identity validation, meaning the SERVICE_AUTH_TOKEN rotates every 60s but is NEVER the sole auth gate — the Envoy sidecar validates the caller's x509 SVID before traffic reaches the pod. Network policy restricts ingress to only the API gateway pod (label: app=api-gateway) on port 3000.

config.apparmor_profile: runtime/default with custom deny rules for paths outside /app/** and /tmp/**
config.service_mesh: Istio 1.20, STRICT mTLS, PeerAuthentication requiring valid SPIFFE SVID
config.network_policy: ingress only from app=api-gateway on port 3000
